target.claim_scope: Re-execute the archived Figure 2 program and compare its numerical and rendered artifacts with the archived reference image.
excluded_claims: independent validation of the full DiffeRT2d paper
validation of radio-propagation accuracy against measurements
reproduction of every figure, benchmark, or software claim

outcome_rules.exact: The process exits successfully, all required artifacts pass hash verification, the numerical grid is 300 by 300, and generated and archived PNG pixel arrays are identical.
outcome_rules.visually_consistent: All exact gates except pixel identity pass, image shapes match, and normalized pixel mean absolute error is at most 0.01.
outcome_rules.artifact_divergence: Execution succeeds and artifacts are complete, but the image comparison exceeds the declared visual threshold or shapes differ.
outcome_rules.failed: Source, environment, execution, required-artifact, or evidence-integrity validation fails.
